note: Main study order (ResEnc -> Primus -> SegMamba -> Swin UNETR), fold 0 of every model first. ResEnc fold 0 is the whole-head pilot run (tag 'default'). Training length comes from protocol.TRAINING_SAMPLES. GPU on gpu-a240: the queue picks the smallest free GPU that fits peak_GB x 1.15 + 1 GiB (10 GB slice < 20 GB slice < full A100; see queue.fitting_gres); on blackwell a job starts only when the GPU has that much free memory. peak_GB = measured torch max_memory_allocated in a training step at the configuration and batch size the model trains with. MACHINES (2026-11-21): each model's folds are spread over both machines, so any small machine difference averages out instead of lining up with one model; 'machine' maps fold -> machine. A fold 0 that ran on the other machine is declared in 'fold0_external' (verdict, tag, lr_factor) once it has finished; until then that machine's later folds wait.
